sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras. 1x body camera charger reported missing.
Morning shift deployed. Alpha Route commenced.
Welfare check completed inside Starbucks. Guards maintained visible presence along Queen Street and scoped the area for possible issues.
Corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street checked. All clear.
Corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street checked. All clear.
Arrived at Imperial Lane. Floor checks completed. All clear.
Welfare check completed inside McDonald’s Britomart. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full walkthrough completed and welfare checks commenced on stores and businesses in the area. All clear.
Security presence maintained while awaiting response calls and incidents.
Welfare check completed through Queens Wharf dock. All clear.
Welfare check completed at OK Gift Shop. No issues found.
Arrived at Lorne Street and Wellesley Street check-in. All clear.
Welfare checks completed inside Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Response call from McDonald’s Queen Street regarding a trespassed individual sitting inside the store. Immediate removal requested.

Arrived at McDonald’s Queen Street. Guards asked the POI to leave; he became irritated and verbally aggressive. Police and Auckland Council nearby heard the commotion and took over. Bodycam footage captured.
Guards left standby at McDonald’s Queen Street for Police to continue. Welfare checks completed at Mrs Higgins, Mid City, and 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Remedy Coffee. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Response call from Amelia Bakery and Cafe regarding two street vagrants sleeping in front of the store and refusing to move along. Assistance requested.
Arrived at Amelia Bakery and Cafe. Guards woke the two vagrants and asked them to vacate as the store was opening. Both complied and packed up to move along. Bodycam footage captured.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. Welfare checks commenced on stores and businesses. All clear.
Walkthrough commenced along Federal Street, checking stores and businesses.
Team 2 deployed and assigned to cover the lower CBD sector.
Arrived at corner of Cook Street. No concerns identified.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive. Welfare checks completed. All clear.
Patrol continued and standby ended due to no concerns.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no activity visible.
Welfare check completed at Auckland Library. All clear.
Arrived at Lorne Street and Wellesley Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Remedy Coffee. All clear.
Arrived at Elliott Street Apartments. Welfare check completed through Atrium on Elliott. No issues.
Welfare checks completed at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street. All clear.
Arrived at headquarters for a quick restroom break.
Left headquarters and maintained presence within Queen Street.
No problematic activity. Guards returned to headquarters for morning interval.
Morning interval completed. Charlie Route ended.
Arrived at Lorne Street and Victoria Street. Welfare checks commenced.
Arrived at Lorne Street and Wellesley Street. No issues.
Welfare check completed at Auckland Library. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Nando’s, Munster Inn, and Queens Food Court. All clear.
Walkthrough completed along Wakefield Street. No issues.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full sweep completed. Welfare checks completed inside Aotea Centre, Jack’s Fried Chicken, and Metro Entertainment City.
Patrol continued towards headquarters for sector exchange with Team 2.
Arrived at headquarters. Quick debrief with Team 2. Bravo Route ended.
Walkthrough completed along Durham Street East alleyway. All clear.
Welfare checks commenced along High Street stores and businesses. All clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women’s Memorial Hall. No issues found.
Arrived at Chancery Square. Full sweep completed. No issues found.
Welfare checks completed along Courthouse Lane, O’Connell Lane, and Vulcan Lane. All clear.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark. Welfare checks completed with stores and static guards. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Fort Street. Welfare checks completed on stores and businesses. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no activity occurring.
Arrived at Kiwibank. Stores and businesses checked. No issues found.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Full sweep completed, including McDonald’s Britomart. All clear.
Guards returned to headquarters for lunch break.
Lunch break commenced while preparing for afternoon shift.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Welfare check sweep completed down Queen Street while heading towards Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay sweep completed with no issues. Proceeded towards Chancery Square.
Full sweep along High Street completed. All clear. Continued towards Freyberg Square and Chancery Square.
Freyberg Square sweep completed. No issues.
Chancery Square welfare sweep completed. Returned onto High Street and lower Queen Street to maintain presence.
Security presence maintained. Moved along lower Queen Street.
Commercial Bay, Tyler Street, and Commerce Street checked. Proceeded up Hobson Street towards the Cathedral.
Cathedral welfare check completed. All clear. Proceeded to Victoria Street then back onto Queen Street.
Victoria Street and Federal Street welfare sweep completed. No issues.
Final sweep commenced down lower Queen Street.

Lower Queen Street welfare sweep completed. No issues from Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, Shortland Street, High Street, Gore Street, Fort Street, Freyberg Square, and Chancery Square. Returned to headquarters for route changeover.
Debrief completed with Team 1 and sectors switched.
Welfare patrol commenced up Queen Street towards Aotea Square.
Welfare sweep completed along Queen Street, Lorne Street, and Auckland Library. Stood by at Aotea Square while updating reports.
Reports updated. Completed welfare checks on Elliott Street and Darby Street.
Welfare sweep completed on Elliott Street, Darby Street, Victoria Street, and Federal Street. Returned to upper Queen Street.
Security presence maintained. Returned to headquarters for route changeover.
Route changeover completed. Response call from Nike reporting a potential theft. Vagrant last seen with a blue hoodie over the shoulders, heading down Queen Street towards Commercial Bay.
POI stopped and searched on lower Queen Street. No stolen items from Nike found. Team continued to monitor the vagrant towards Commercial Bay.
Welfare sweep completed along Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, and Shortland Street. Arrived at Commercial Bay.
Welfare sweep completed at Commercial Bay, Commerce Street, and Tyler Street. Proceeded up High Street towards Chancery Square and Freyberg Square.
Welfare sweep completed at Gore Street, Fort Street, and High Street. Arrived at Chancery Square.
Chancery Square welfare sweep completed. Patrol continued through the rest of High Street.
Remaining High Street welfare sweep completed. No issues.
Lower Queen Street welfare sweep completed. Stood by while heading back towards headquarters.
No issues reported by local stores on lower Queen Street. 30-minute break commenced.
Team 2 stood down. Debrief with Team 1 completed. All equipment returned.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:35 – 22:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Body Vests, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Keycards, 4x Sets of Keys, 1x Phone Charger.
Response call from Nike Queen Street regarding a male believed to have taken items. Team 2 proceeded to handle the Nike incident.

Arrived at Victoria Street East and Queen Street headquarters check-in. Welfare checks completed at Starbucks Queen Street, Lotus Foreign Exchange, Nike, Cotton On, and Localito Convenience Store. All clear.

Welfare checks completed at Footlocker, Cosmetic Clinic, Unichem Pharmacy, McDonald’s Queen Street, Mrs Higgins, Timezone, ChaPanda, BBQ Chicken, Whimsical Blu, Acceco Supermarket, and Bobao Bar. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Civic Theatre, Starks, 185° Sandwiches, Yes Convenience Store, and Yoghurt Story. All clear.
Welfare check interrupted by response call from Community Patrol requesting assistance moving Chuma along from Darby Street station underground, as she refused to move.
Arrived at Darby Street station. Guards spoke to Chuma and asked her to move along. She slowly complied and left.
Security presence maintained between Darby Street and Queen Street.
Welfare checks continued towards Aotea Square — Uncle Tetsu, Burger Fuel, Luv Sushi, Daiso Japan Mart, Game On, Jack’s Cafeteria, and Jack’s Fried Chicken. All clear.
Arrived at Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Aotea Centre and The Terrace. All clear.
Response call from Amelia Cafe, top of Victoria Street, regarding a male inside the store whom staff wanted moved along.
Arrived at Amelia Cafe. The individual (male, black hoodie) had already left. Guards stood by in case he returned.

Patrol resumed. Welfare checks completed on Victoria Street West and Federal Street, including Amelia Cafe, Printshop, Salon 101, Kiwi Souvenirs, Vphix Mobiles, Izmir Kebab and Grill, Little Tiger Dumpling, Mr Tacos, Bagel Love, Yogi’s Haircut, The Fiddler, Hell Pizza, JD Convenience Store, Dollar Dealers, Casa Victoria, Kebab Time, and Sky Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Scrunchy Millers, Cinnamon Squared, City Liquor, Fern, Lord Nelson’s Steak House, Mr Katsu, Kiwi Gift, and Woolworths Victoria Street West. All clear.
Guards returned to headquarters to charge Ops phone, which was at 14%.
While charging the Ops phone, response call from Hasi regarding a male urinating in public.
Guards located the male at Localito Convenience Store and asked him not to expose himself or urinate in public. He complied.
Guards stood by to monitor in case the behaviour recurred.
Returned to headquarters to continue charging Ops phone.
Ops phone reached a healthy battery level. Patrol resumed. Team 2 had already clocked off.
Welfare checks completed at Bag Planet, Mobile Planet, Ippondo, Fun Tech, Sale Shop, Ava Chi, Hulucat, Banh Mi, Subway, and 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare check completed through Mid City Arcade and surrounding stores. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Strand Arcade and surrounding stores. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Atrium food court. All clear.
Guards returned to headquarters to conduct building sweep.
Noted that Chuma and the Hasi response footage are on the Duress Eagle camera.
Guards stood by at 220 Queen Street headquarters entrance as directed by Hasi due to a sliding door malfunction (door staying open). Remained vigilant while awaiting the repair technician.
Door repair technician arrived. Guards resumed routes.
Response call from McDonald’s Queen Street regarding a male inside the premises whom staff wanted removed.
Arrived at McDonald’s Queen Street. Manager identified the male vagrant; guards advised him to leave. He complied with no issues. Security presence maintained.
With most stores closed, welfare checks focused on open businesses, including convenience stores and both McDonald’s branches.
Welfare checks completed at Celine Mediterranean Cuisine, Mali Thai, Pizza Club, Tandoori, Domino’s, Freshmarket Store, and Wilson Carpark food stalls. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Sky Mart Convenience Store, Lord Nelson’s Steak House, City Liquor, JD Convenience Store, and Woolworths Victoria Street West. All clear.
Security presence maintained at top of Victoria Street.
Guards proceeded towards bottom of Queen Street.
Welfare checks completed through Durham Street East and West alleyways and surrounding stores. All clear.
Welfare checks completed along Queen Street stores, ensuring no visible damage. All clear.
Arrived at Shortland Street and Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Shortland Street Convenience Store and Taco Bell. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Evans Kebab, Vape Haven, Right Track Sports Bar, Murdoch’s, Seoul Night, KFC, Vapor King, and Jo & Joe. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at McDonald’s Britomart and Movenpick Hotel. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Q Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store, Discount Dairy, and Vape Shop. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Ace Karaoke and Good To Go Supermarket. All clear.
Guards stood by at Wyndham Street and Albert Street. All clear.
Lunch break finished. Stood by for night shift changeover.

While returning for changeover, guards noticed a male being assaulted at the ANZ ATM by a female. Guards intervened, separated both individuals, and called Police. Guards remained on site until authorities arrived to arrest the female. Incident uploaded to Auror.
